name: RB: Axolotl
source:
Taking place in a tank suspended in a cosmic wonderland, five Axolotl appear one day from a mysterious, thundering void. The Axolotl quickly learn they are able to speak with one another, and relationships are formed. However, something is off. Each Axolotl seems to possess knowledge they should not know. Foods, and people, and places and concepts... And obsessions. Some feel a lot of pain. Some want to inflict pain. Some want to forget pain...  

And who is this [RB] person that keeps appearing, anyway?  

Take in some mystery, some science fiction, some action, and some character drama, add in a pinch of the authors personal reflections of pain, anxieties and depression, and this is what you get. Surely, there are many things that can be said, but RB: Axolotl is unlike anything you’ve ever seen before.

[From [url=https://actawesome.itch.io/rb-axolotl] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个悬浮在宇宙仙境中的水箱中，有一天，五只蝾螈从神秘、雷鸣般的虚空中出现。蝾螈很快就知道它们能够互相交谈，并建立了关系。然而，有些事情不对劲。每只蝾螈似乎都拥有他们不应该知道的知识。食物、人、地点和概念……还有痴迷。有些人感到很痛苦。有些人想要造成痛苦。有些人想忘记痛苦…  

那个不断出现的[RB]人到底是谁？

吸收一些悬疑小说、科幻小说、动作小说和人物戏剧，再加上作者对痛苦、焦虑和抑郁的个人反思，这就是你得到的。当然，有很多事情可以说，但RB：蝾螈与你以前见过的任何东西都不一样。

[来自[url=https://actawesome.itch.io/rb-axolotl] itch.io[/url]]
